en.title: Automate browser workflows
en.description: Drive a browser using Playwright CLI snapshots, locators, and a bundled wrapper.
tasks: Drive a browser using Playwright CLI snapshots, locators, and a bundled wrapper.
prerequisites: Node.js/npm and browser binaries. Upstream wrapper uses $CODEX_HOME/skills/playwright/.
en.example: Use playwright. Open my local app, search for an item, and capture the resulting page without submitting purchases.
en.expectedResult: A reproducible interaction sequence and screenshots or extracted page state.
limitations: Requires a host that allows browser control and terminal execution.

zh.title: 自动化浏览器流程
zh.description: 使用 Playwright CLI 快照、定位器和包内封装驱动浏览器。
tasks: 使用 Playwright CLI 快照、定位器和包内封装驱动浏览器。
prerequisites: Node.js/npm 与浏览器组件。上游封装使用 $CODEX_HOME/skills/playwright/。
zh.example: 请使用 playwright：打开我的本地应用，搜索一个条目并截图，不提交购买操作。
zh.expectedResult: 可复现的操作序列、截图或页面状态。
limitations: 需要宿主允许浏览器控制与终端执行。
